title: `Range` does not work as expected when exp_edit is enabled and min_value is 0
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in master, 4.7.1, 4.8-dev2

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (159701651) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.19003) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.14 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

- Related issue: #109248

When a `Range` has exp_edit enabled and min_value set to 0, updating the `value` via the `ratio` property causes `value` to grow from 1 and not 0. `value` approaches 0 when given a negative ratio.

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var r = Range.new()
	
	r.exp_edit = true
	r.step = 0.0
	r.min_value = 0.0
	
	r.ratio = 0.0 
	print(r.value) # 1.0
	r.ratio = 0.01
	print(r.value) # 1.0471285480509
	r.ratio = -1
	print(r.value) # 0.01
```
Any minimum value other than 0 works as expected.


This also affects any scene inheriting `Range` that updates the value via the ratio, such as `HSlider` and `VSlider`. The slider can be dragged further than it should be (since the slider value approaches 0 only with a negative ratio), see video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ddc8e330-3f80-4251-bf22-232e5acbeb0a


### Steps to reproduce

- Create a `Range`, set exp_edit to true and min_value to 0
- Set the `ratio` property to 0
- Observe that `value` is now 1 instead of the expected 0

---
- Alternatively download the mrp which contains the script in the issue description and the slider used in the video.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[range_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30391925/range_bug.zip)
